info.name: Generalizable — Hugging Face CT analysis (DEMO ONLY)
info.description: Educational, research-only descriptions of CT slices from public open-source data, via the Hugging Face Inference Providers router (OpenAI-compatible). Not a diagnosis, no prognosis. Set the collection variable HF_TOKEN (a fine-grained token with 'Make calls to Inference Providers'). IMAGE_B64: run `scripts/ml/hf_analyze.py head --dry-run`, then `base64 -i build/ml/head_axial.png | pbcopy`.
